feeds.title: Christian Finance Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Ben, and I am the main writer behind the Christian Finance Blog. Christian Finance is a blog all about a Christian's view on the vast world of personal finance.

feeds.title: Luke1428
feeds.description: Brian helps individuals and families to navigate the challenges of managing their money with a spiritual angle so that they can grow wealth and live with greater peace of mind.

feeds.title: Seedtime Blog
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Bob Lotich. This site contains the lessons I learned on my journey from being a stingy, debt-ridden fool, to being able to give more than I ever dreamed, having a paid off house by age 31, and joy with money in the process.

feeds.title: Agape Investing » Faith & Financing
feeds.description: Covers articles about faith, finance, real estate, business, and entrepreneurship. Equipping young professionals with excellent money management skills that are rooted in the Gospel so they can live in God's abundance and pursue their callings without hesitation. Agape Investing helps young professionals learn how to become more like Jesus in the way that they manage their money. Our mission is to help ambitious young professionals become excellent money managers so they can live abundantly, give generously, and radically transform the kingdom of God.

feeds.title: Michel A Bell Stewardship
feeds.description: Devoted to presenting Christian financial advice and biblical stewardship principles and practices to individuals, couples, and groups. Managing God's Money helps Christians become better stewards of resources using different media to provide Christian financial advice (lifestyle counselling) that promotes debt free lifestyles and minimize daily stress.

feeds.title: Guide Financial Planning Blog
feeds.description: Covers topics such as personal finance, financial planning, charitable giving, taxes, insurance and much more. Guide Financial Planning is a Christian, fee-only financial planning firm that offers virtual services, whose financial advisors are Christian CFP professionals.

feeds.title: Christian Financial Advisors Blog
feeds.description: Christian Financial Advisors (formerly CIS Wealth) aims to provide financial services with a Biblical worldview.

feeds.title: Faith and Finances Blog
feeds.description: The Faith and Finances Ministry helps Christians do well spiritually and financially (financial discipline, healthy perspective about money, wealth growth, godly generosity).

feeds.title: Bible Money Matters
feeds.description: Welcome to BibleMoneyMatters.com - a Christian personal finance blog that helps regular people gain control of their finances and live financially free. Hopefully, Bible Money Matters can play a small part in helping you create your financial blueprint so that down the road you can give more, save more and live more!

feeds.title: Celebrating Financial Freedom Blog
feeds.description: Covers a range of articles on budgeting, financial freedom, and more.The blog helps to get your finances organized by teaching the basics of managing money well, saving up, and setting oneself up for success using biblical principles.

feeds.title: Donovan Brooks Blog
feeds.description: Storyline Financial Planning's latest blog posts & content for Christians striving to be better stewards by aligning their personal finances with their faith.

feeds.title: Faith+Finance Blog
feeds.description: Faith+Finance is bringing together pastors and impact investors, theologians and social entrepreneurs, and other faith and business leaders to respond with courage and imagination to the most urgent and demanding economic, social, environmental, and spiritual challenges of our day.

feeds.title: Money Wise Steward
feeds.description: Apryl is a stay-at-home mom that loves Jesus, she shares money-saving tips, budgeting tips, extra income ideas, and faith in Jesus.

feeds.title: Personal Finance Journey
feeds.description: Covers topics such as personal finance, savings, credit, debt, finance, and personal development. Personal Finance Journey offers insight into everyday situations that impact our decisions about how we spend, save and invest money.
